package.description: A tool for reading, displaying and saving data from the NanoVNA

en-US.description: A tool for reading, displaying and saving data from the NanoVNA
en-US.longDescription: A multiplatform tool to save Touchstone files from the NanoVNA, sweep frequency spans in segments to gain more than 101 data points, and generally display and analyze the resulting data.
en-US.name: NanoVNASaver
